reviews.author: Crystal Bost
reviews.text: Our car left us stranded on a busy highway, this past Monday morning, on the way to take our granddaughter to school. We called 77 Towing and they came out quickly. Towed our car to where we needed it. Whole experience was super smooth. We appreciate their kindness and professionalism. And we highly recommend them! A++

reviews.author: P Gain
reviews.text: Professional, affordable, and an all around great experience. Most times when someone needs a tow truck it is bad enough, Jonah and his team make it less painful. Great communication and appreciate the team.

reviews.author: Stephanie C.
reviews.text: These guys are outstanding when it comes to towing! Very impressed with their pricing & delivery of my very special cargo. Thank y'all again, honestly if you need a tow call these guys, you won't regret the outcome.

reviews.author: Becky B
reviews.text: Highly recommended!!! Very professional, caring, and treated my mom's car like it was their own. Very responsive, appreciative, and cost was great. Thank you so much for helping out in a pinch and for being so kind! Will be using them again!!!

reviews.author: rebel
reviews.text: Disgusting man and disgusting company. Charged over the price of what was actually on the sign. Do not recommend targets nice cars to make a quick buck and profits nothing this place needs to be shut down!

reviews.author: Caroline Bishop
reviews.text: These people were trying to take my car when they were looking for a different car. They are both the same car (Ford Flex) but he didn’t even check the vin number nor the color of the car. Mine is silver and the one he was looking for was a dark grey! I have contacted a lawyer about this situation. I am beyond pissed and glad it was caught before he took off with my car. Obviously he doesn’t do his job correctly and needs to pay attention and check vin numbers and color! I also have video and photos of this as well!

reviews.author: LaNya Ray
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I showed 77 towing respect and kindness and we received the same in return. We really appreciate you guys for your kindness in the mist of very stressful situations. If we ever need towing again we know who to call!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Phillips
reviews.text: Excellent service. Super friendly. Got to us within 30 minutes and was a decent price. An extra shout-out to our driver as well. He was just cool as hell.

reviews.author: Dylan Chapman
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Jonah. He was not only professional, he was also friendly. My son enjoyed watching him get our van loaded up (which took all of about 3 min). We then chatted for a bit about some of the stories he's accumulated over the years. It's always great when you get to connect with good people. Also, you'll likely notice that most of the negative reviews are from individuals who involuntarily had to have their vehicles towed (repossessions, etc.). So don't let those negative reviews fool you. 77 Towing was great and I wouldn't hesitate to use them again.

reviews.author: Kryston Evans
reviews.text: I want to thank 77 towing for quick and outstanding service. Called them at the last minute for a tow and Bobby showed up within an half hour and was very professional. I work in the automotive field and there are a lot of tow companies that the drivers and dispatchers are very rude but not with 77 they were very polite and professional and took good care of my vehicle. Will definitely recommend. Thanks again Bobby

reviews.author: Achraf Hamriti
reviews.text: I had a horrible experience with this towing company. They towed my car within just 15 minutes of it being parked, which felt completely unfair and opportunistic. When I went to retrieve my car, they charged me an outrageous $400 and insisted on cash-only payment. To make things worse, the receipt they provided had no official stamp or proof of payment, leaving me feeling scammed. Their customer service was rude and unhelpful, adding to the frustration. This company operates with shady practices.

reviews.author: Michelle Pearson
reviews.text: My car was legitimately towed. That’s on me. However, my complaint is about a towing company who can tow your car and return it back to you at their convenience. This company seems to have a contract with the business where I was parked. They went back and forth towing cars as people parked. I told as many as I could not to park there. When I went to pick up my car no one was at the car lot. A gentleman had been waiting 15-20 mins before my arrival & I waited another 35-40 mins. I called the owner (who wouldn’t give his name twice). His excuse for not being there wasn’t my problem just as my ability to pay his excessive $300 cash wasn’t his problem. This seems like price gauging as the lot was located less than 15 mins from the business towed. It is extremely unfair and unprofessional to tow someone’s car & not have someone there available during business hours for pick up. With the excessive price gauging amount of $300 Cash per car, they should have someone available at open hours so you can pick up your vehicle. He didn’t offer any kind of discount for the hour wait. I was just standing outside of the lot: thank goodness it was not raining, I did not know the area, I felt unsafe, it looked like a dog could come around the corner any minute and attack. This is the worst towing company! The only reason I gave 1 Star is you have to give at least give a 1 in order to leave a review.

reviews.author: Daisy Rivas
reviews.text: This place is a disgrace, towed my childs car without calling an adult to let them know they parked in the wrong spot. And yes my daughter has a full driver’s license, knows how to drive but unfortunately parked in the waterburgers lot. I called the guy to ask him why he took the car without calling an adult and saya he gave her the option to drop it for $150 but since she didn’t have any money he took the car. If you see a its a child why would she have $150 on hand!? CALL AN ADULT!!!! You left her stranded!!!You are heartless! I hope your children never have to go through this!!! DO NOT USE THESE PEOPLE! And on top of that says I now have to pay $300 over the phone then texts me the address and says its now $400! Ridiculous!

reviews.author: Lauren Early
reviews.text: I called when my son had drive off into a ditch, which as many can understand this was obviously not my finest time. I probably could have been allot nicer but the gentleman on the other end of the phone, he was very calm and so nice to me. He called me when he got him out and assured me that he was fine as was the vehicle. I would totally recommend them to anyone! Wow great service and he was so calm! This guy was so awesome I made him a Yelp page if your not using him for your towing needs your missing out!

reviews.author: Bonnie Asher-McDaniel
reviews.text: This is by far the best towing company I have ever used. As someone who recently and unexpectedly became a widow, they helped me in more ways than one. Bobby was so kind and gracious. Thank you, 77 Towing & Recovery.

reviews.author: Brooke Stephens-Tarlton
reviews.text: Great customer service. Within a hour of my first phone call to 77 towing. My car was at my house. Super nice and will definitely recommend them and use them in the future!

reviews.author: Jon
reviews.text: I called ahead of time to see if the guy could meet me to tow my car at 11am. I was told it may be 11:15 or 11:30. Turns out he showed up at 11 afterall! He hooked the vehicle up very quickly and had it going down the road to the mechanic shop in minutes. Very nice guy and amazing service. Thank you!

reviews.author: ashley Kay
reviews.text: Him and his wife were both so friendly ! They also came right away when my sisters tire blew out on the side of 85. I also feel like they don’t rip you off via price like some tow companies do. While I hope I don’t have to use them again, if I need a tow truck they are definitely who I will be calling :)

reviews.author: Lori Fike
reviews.text: Jonah came to rescue my 16 year old daughter when she managed to creatively back her car halfway down a ditch. He arrived quickly and was kind, professional and reasonably priced. He expertly removed the car and took the time to make sure it was safe for her to drive. I would highly recommend him for ant towing needs.

reviews.author: Edwin
reviews.text: Called AAA and requested a rollback for a tow from Jonesville NC to Mt. Airy NC on Sunday. They said 77 towing would be there in 1.5 hours. Two hours later called back and they were closed on Sunday and they hung up. I called another company and they said 45 minutes. They showed up and loaded the truck. Would not recommend this company to anyone who needs a tow on Sunday. Two hour's and 45 minutes later, they should have called me back at least.

reviews.author: Omar Lopez
reviews.text: Best experience with this company, I was told they would be at my location in 45 minutes. Exactly what happened! Will strongly recommend anyone to use this company for any towing services, will not let you down.

reviews.author: Laurie Walker
reviews.text: A good friend recommended 77 Towing and I've used them when I got stuck in the mud. I called another service we had been using but he said he couldn't do it most likely because it was a messy job. Jonah came and took it to our mechanic. We just used again 2/21 and Jonah called right back and came when he stated he would.

reviews.author: Jennifer Shoe
reviews.text: It was 3 minutes until they closed and he was still willing to come out and pick up my son's truck. He was so nice and showed up quickly! I can't reccomended him enough!

reviews.author: Leagha Effner
reviews.text: Broke down very far from home, Jonah took great care of a mom and kids stranded with a broken water pump! As a mom and Air Force veteran I cannot thank them enough!

reviews.author: Stephanie Blount
reviews.text: Super nice guy! Picked me up in Huntersville even though they were closed. Would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: stacy dalleinne
reviews.text: Great guy. Amazing service. He was right on time. Very nice. Definitely trust worthy. I cerainly won't be using anybody else. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Antwain Tate
reviews.text: It was a great tow , they got it to my house at the perfect timing an the price couldnt be beat . ver nice people indeed ,will refer plenty of people to this company in the near future

reviews.author: Marcus Esteves
reviews.text: Jonah showed up exactly when he said he would. Not many people keep to their word. 100% would work with y’all again and 100% recommend this towing company!

reviews.author: Zac Moretz
reviews.text: These guys are great, always a quick response, always professional, always a fair price. I have used them many times. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Veronica Pope
reviews.text: On time, courteous and when the driver resolved my issue, saved me the money for the tow and repair! Customer for life!!

reviews.author: Tray Way
reviews.text: The best around. I was stuck at the supermarket on a warm Friday afternoon. They rescued me within 10 mins

reviews.author: Ronald Pritt
reviews.text: They charge a widow $400.00 to tow her car less then a half mile an laughed about it pay up are we keep it

reviews.author: Blair Richard
reviews.text: I locked myself out a couple times with my old truck and he was always quick to respond and very kind. Would only hire him to tow in the future!
